title.rendered: Arqaam Islamic Income Fund has been recognized at the 2026 LSEG Lipper Fund Awards — MENA Markets

content.rendered:
Arqaam Capital is proud to announce that the Arqaam Islamic Income Fund has been recognized at the 2026 LSEG Lipper Fund Awards — MENA Markets, winning across both the 3-year and 5-year horizons in the Domestic Funds universe:

  Best Fund over 3 Years — Bond Sukuk Global USD

Best Fund over 5 Years — Bond Sukuk Global USD  

The Lipper methodology is entirely quantitative — it rewards consistent, risk-adjusted performance against peers over multiple time horizons. To be recognized over both 3 and 5 years, as a domestically domiciled fund, reflects performance earned through the cycle rather than in a single favourable window.  

That consistency is the product of a disciplined, repeatable investment process and a commitment to letting evidence drive positioning — the foundation of how our Fixed Income Asset Management team operates.  

Congratulations to Abdul Kadir Hussain, CFA, Mehdi POPOTTE, CFA, Fady Gendy, CFA, Nadim Amatouri, CFA, Jad Rayess, on this achievement, and our sincere thanks to the investors and distribution partners who continue to place their trust in Arqaam.

View More
